attributes.action: Ban the sale of fireworks to the general public and allow public displays only
attributes.additional_details: The unrestricted sale of fireworks to the public causes preventable injuries, fires, and anti-social behaviour every year. Unannounced backyard displays also cause severe distress to pets, livestock, wildlife, young children, and vulnerable people, including those with PTSD. Restricting fireworks to licensed, controlled public events allows communities to enjoy celebrations safely at predictable times while protecting public safety and animal welfare.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to ban the retail sale and supply of fireworks to the general public. Legislation should restrict the purchase and use of fireworks strictly to licensed professionals operating at organised, controlled public displays

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
